meta.label: Ollama for Dataiku LLM Mesh
meta.description: Connect to a local or remote Ollama server via its OpenAI-compatible API

params.name: base_url
params.label: Ollama Base URL
params.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for Ollama. Use HTTPS for remote endpoints, especially when API Key is set. Use the host IP when DSS and Ollama run on different machines or containers.

params.name: model
params.label: Model
params.description: Full Ollama model name including tag, e.g. llama3.1:latest or qwen2.5:14b

params.name: api_key
params.label: API Key
params.description: Optional bearer token for Ollama Cloud, a reverse proxy, or other secured endpoints. Remote endpoints must use HTTPS when this is set. Leave empty for local Ollama (uses the placeholder key "ollama").

params.name: max_concurrency
params.label: Max concurrent requests
params.description: Maximum concurrent requests for this model. Use 1–2 for large local models (VRAM bound); 8–16 for cloud models.

params.name: enable_streaming
params.label: Enable streaming
params.description: Stream tokens as they arrive. Disable to fall back to one-shot output when a model omits tool calls during streaming.
